verses.text: When the Lamb opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.
Then I saw the seven angels who stand in front of God, and they were given seven trumpets.

Another angel came and stood at the altar, holding a gold pan for burning incense. He was given a lot of incense to offer with the prayers of all God's holy people on the gold altar in front of the throne.
The smoke of the incense, together with the prayers of God's people, went up to God from the angel's hand.
Then the angel took the pan, filled it with fire from the altar, and threw it down on the earth. There came thunder, loud sounds, flashes of lightning, and an earthquake.
Then the seven angels who had the seven trumpets got ready to blow them.

The first angel blew his trumpet. Hail and fire mixed with blood came down on the earth. A third of the earth was burned up, a third of the trees were burned up, and all the green grass was burned up.
The second angel blew his trumpet. Something like a huge mountain on fire was thrown into the sea. A third of the sea turned into blood,
a third of the living creatures in the sea died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.
The third angel blew his trumpet. A great star, burning like a torch, fell from the sky. It fell on a third of the rivers and on the springs of water.
The name of the star is Wormwood. A third of the waters became bitter, and many people died from drinking the water, because it had become bitter.

The fourth angel blew his trumpet. A third of the sun was struck, and a third of the moon, and a third of the stars, so that a third of them became dark. A third of the day had no light, and also a third of the night.

As I watched, I heard an eagle flying high in the sky, calling out in a loud voice: "How terrible! How terrible! How terrible for the people who live on the earth, because of the trumpet blasts the other three angels are about to blow!"
